quarterly_data.signal: At CIOE 2026 (Shenzhen, opened September 9) Accelink ran a live demonstration of a 320x320 OCS all-optical switching system, showing optical path switching and port scheduling in real time; the company pitches it at the multi-tier interconnect and traffic scheduling needs of AI computing centers, citing rate independence, low insertion loss, low power and low latency versus electrical switching. A demonstration only; no customers, volumes or availability date stated.
